translated_text: TELEGRAM: SAVOY-CARLTON TELEPHONE: SAVOY CARLTON SERIES: 3700-3705 Hotels Savoy-Carlton Bratislava, October 14, 1935 PRESSBURG-POZSONY My dearest, my love! I am about to leave here and wanted to quickly write you a few lines. You know, even though you weren't there, my dearest, I have grown so fond of Bratislava that even in retrospect, all the wonderful memories are still very beautiful. Today I am traveling on to Carpathia, Russia. Since I don't know how to write to you, please come home. Everything will be possible for me very soon. And to my family, I congratulate you on the one from Pestry Vicen. How much did you get for that? – If you continue like this, you'll end up under my thumb, you very fine person. Probably not yet. But I can tell you that I also work quite well, even though I have such a fat wallet as you. But one of us has to have more, and right now it's you. Just imagine how much I'm happy for you. I was often with Ravel Weissmann. He sends his best regards. For the comfort of both of you, you'll hear from your Bob again soon. AV VA 3 ACISCO D PIŠTE VADRESE ULICU A ČÍSLO DOMU n 3.
